Hemoglobin: 20 g/dL
Hematocrit: 60%

Now he's also feeling dizzy and nauseous, which goes away when he steps outside to shovel snow. That's interesting because being outside seems to relieve his symptoms, which might suggest something related to his environment. Looking at his medical history, he has hypertension, type II diabetes, and asthma. His medications include amlodipine (which is a calcium channel blocker for blood pressure), metformin and glimepiride (both for diabetes), and a fluticasone/salmeterol inhaler, which is for asthma. So, no recent changes in medications that I can tell. He's been living at his upstate cabin for five weeks and hasn't traveled elsewhere recently.
